question: Which Indian Prime Minister translated the epic Telugu novel into Hindi which is named as 'Sahasra Phan'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P. V. Narasimha Rao.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A** Telugu Novel **was translated into Hindi by India's 9th Prime minister Sri PV Narasimha Rao, with the name Sahasra Phan.
 
• The original novel, Veyi Padagal, was written by** Viswanath Satyanarayana.**
 
• The Hindi translation, **Sahasra Phan, **was done in the year 1968. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The novel was also translated from Hindi into Sanskrit with the same name by Prabhavati Devi. 
 
• In 1976, **Chandrakant Mehta and Mahendra Dhave** translated this novel into Gujarati.
 
• Later, **R.V.S. Sundaram** translated the work into Kannada.
 
• In 1998, it was published in a** Kannada newspaper as Nootana. **
